cases.name: record-locals-and-retained-aliases
cases.source:
def parse(row):
    raw = row['amount']
    amount = int(raw.strip())
    return amount, raw, raw
row = {'amount': ' 19 '}
amount, first, second = parse(row)
print(amount, first is second, second is row['amount'])

cases.name: record-converter-default-and-rebinding
cases.source:
def parse(row, convert=int):
    raw = row['amount']
    amount = convert(raw)
    saved = raw
    return amount, saved, raw
row = {'amount': '23'}
int = lambda value: 42
amount, first, second = parse(row)
print(amount, first is second, second is row['amount'])
print(parse(row, lambda value: 9)[0])
